import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

repo=Path.cwd()
task=repo/'.local/tool-tasks/action-route-prefix-reuse-20261007'
runs=[]
for scene in ('dev-06-silent-boss','dev-09-necrobinder-boss'):
    source=json.loads((task/'pure'/scene/'2-candidate/command.json').read_text())
    out=task/'cost-diagnostic'/scene
    out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    command=source['command'].copy()
    command[command.index('--out')+1]=str(out)
    command[command.index('--label')+1]='exact-route-cost-'+scene
    env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('OFFLINE_HARNESS_',
         'COMBATSOLVER_VERIFY','TASK_EXACT_PATH_MEMO','DOTNET_PerfMap'))}
    env['OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL']=source['runtimeDll']
    env['TASK_EXACT_PATH_MEMO_DIAGNOSTIC']=str(out/'memo-counters.json')
    source.update(command=command,diagnosticOnly=True,environmentOverrides={
        k:v for k,v in env.items() if k.startswith(('OFFLINE_HARNESS_','TASK_EXACT_PATH_MEMO'))})
    (out/'command.json').write_text(json.dumps(source,indent=2)+'\n')
    with (out/'launcher.log').open('w') as log:
        completed=subprocess.run(command,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=120)
    h=json.loads((out/'harness-result.json').read_text())
    c=json.loads((task/'pure'/scene/'2-candidate/harness-result.json').read_text())
    counts=json.loads((out/'memo-counters.json').read_text())
    run=dict(scene=scene,exitCode=completed.returncode,command=source,counters=counts,
        controlMatch={k:h[k]==c[k] for k in ('root','budget','searchPolicy','comparisonQuality','pruneCounters')},
        comparisonQuality=h['comparisonQuality'],pruneCounters=h['pruneCounters'])
    runs.append(run)
    (task/'cost-diagnostic-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(runs,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(run,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
    if completed.returncode!=0: raise RuntimeError('Retain diagnostic failure; do not retry unchanged input.')

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import time

repo = Path.cwd()
task = repo / '.local/tool-tasks/action-route-prefix-reuse-20261007'
prior = repo / '.local/tool-tasks/action-transition-opportunity-20261007/transition-observation'
runs = []
for scene in ('dev-08-regent-boss', 'dev-09-necrobinder-boss', 'dev-06-silent-boss'):
    previous_command = json.loads((prior / scene / 'command.json').read_text())
    command = list(previous_command['command'])
    out = task / 'route-observation' / scene
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    command[1] = str(task / 'harness-observer/OfflineSearchHarness.dll')
    command[command.index('--out') + 1] = str(out)
    command[command.index('--label') + 1] = 'action-route-' + scene
    environment = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items()
                   if not k.startswith(('OFFLINE_HARNESS_', 'COMBATSOLVER_VERIFY', 'DOTNET_PerfMap'))}
    environment['OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL'] = str(repo / '.local/tool-tasks/open-potion-primary-proof-20261007/build-candidate-v4/CombatSolver.dll')
    environment['OFFLINE_HARNESS_TRANSITION_PROBE'] = '1'
    environment['OFFLINE_HARNESS_TRANSITION_ROUTE_PROBE'] = '1'
    (out / 'command.json').write_text(json.dumps({**previous_command, 'command': command,
        'sourceBase': '35ef9e07', 'probe': 'Full ordered action route census',
        'environmentOverrides': {k: v for k, v in environment.items() if k.startswith('OFFLINE_HARNESS_')}
    }, indent=2) + '\n')
    started = time.monotonic()
    with (out / 'launcher.log').open('w') as log:
        completed = subprocess.run(command, env=environment, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                                   timeout=previous_command['outerTimeoutSeconds'])
    result = json.loads((out / 'result.json').read_text())
    harness = json.loads((out / 'harness-result.json').read_text())
    control = json.loads((prior / scene / 'harness-result.json').read_text())
    observations = json.loads((out / 'action-transition-probe.json').read_text())
    comparison = {k: harness[k] == control[k]
                  for k in ('comparisonQuality', 'root', 'searchPolicy', 'budget', 'solverMetrics', 'pruneCounters')}
    # Solver elapsed/GC attribution is diagnostic and varies. Quality and semantic
    # work counters remain separately archived rather than compared as one value.
    run = dict(scene=scene, exitCode=completed.returncode, status=result['status'],
               launcherWallSeconds=time.monotonic() - started, controlMatch=comparison,
               observations=observations, command=json.loads((out / 'command.json').read_text()),
               harnessResult=harness, result=result)
    runs.append(run)
    (task / 'route-observation-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(runs, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(dict(scene=scene, status=result['status'], controlMatch=comparison,
        completed=observations['Completed'], repeats=observations['Repeats'],
        routeRepeats=observations['RouteRepeats'], routeProfileMatches=observations['RouteDifferentProfileMatches'],
